verdict.rationale: Token2's evidence covers local management of FIDO2/PIV/TOTP hardware keys and a bulk-enrollment script that calls Microsoft's Graph API. Nothing shows Token2 issuing its own scoped or least-privilege API credentials for agents, and the probes found no OpenAPI or API surface. Credential issuance is a fair question for an authentication vendor, so the axis applies, but there is no evidence it is delivered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
